monument--noun.def: A structure built to remember a person or an event.
monument--noun.ex: A monument stands in the square.

transformation--noun.def: A complete change in form or appearance.
transformation--noun.ex: The garden's transformation took a year.

counseling--noun.def: Professional advice given to help with problems.

combine--verb.def: To join two or more things together.
combine--verb.ex: Combine the flour and the eggs.

limp--verb.def: To walk with difficulty because of an injured leg.

parachute--noun.def: Cloth that opens to slow your fall from a plane.

analyze--verb.def: To examine something carefully in order to understand it.

wildlife--noun.def: Animals and plants living in natural conditions.

frustration--noun.def: The annoyed feeling of being unable to succeed.

significance--noun.def: The importance or meaning of something.

illegally--adv.def: In a way that breaks the law.

trim--noun.def: A small cut to make something neat.

virtual--adj.def: Existing on a computer rather than in the real world.

substantial--adj.exTr: Hatırı sayılır bir kâr elde ettiler.

ache--noun.ex: I have an ache in my back.

emerge--verb.def: To come out or become known.
emerge--verb.ex: The sun emerged from the clouds.

mineral--noun.def: A natural substance found in the earth.
mineral--noun.ex: The region is rich in minerals.

meaningful--adj.def: Having a clear and serious purpose.

mediterranean--noun.def: The sea between Europe and Africa.

queue--noun.def: A line of people waiting for something.

spelling--noun.def: The way letters are put together to make a word.
spelling--noun.ex: Check the spelling of her name.

headline--noun.def: The title of a newspaper story in large letters.

tablet--noun.def: A small flat computer, or a piece of solid medicine.

mend--verb.def: To repair something that is broken or torn.

jumper--noun.def: A warm knitted top, in British English.
jumper--noun.ex: Wear a jumper, it is cold.

worthwhile--adj.def: Important or useful enough to justify the effort.

remedy--noun.def: A cure for an illness, or a solution to a problem.

damp--adj.def: Slightly wet in an unpleasant way.
damp--adj.ex: The cellar is cold and damp.

vein--noun.def: A tube that carries blood back to the heart.
vein--noun.ex: The nurse found a vein quickly.

steep--adj.ex: The path is very steep here.

accidental--adj.def: Happening by chance and not planned.

convey--verb.def: To communicate a feeling or an idea.

mourn--verb.def: To feel and show deep sadness after a death.
mourn--verb.ex: The town mourned its old teacher.
mourn--verb.exTr: Kasaba eski öğretmeni için yas tuttu.

tornado--noun.def: A violent spinning column of wind.

loaf--noun.def: Bread baked in one large piece.

furthermore--adv.def: In addition, used in formal writing.

harness--noun.def: Straps used to control an animal or hold a person safely.

orderly--adj.ex: The files are in orderly rows.

scold--verb.def: To speak angrily to someone who did wrong.
scold--verb.exTr: Annesi onu yumuşak bir şekilde azarladı.

certainty--noun.def: The state of being completely sure.

mailbox--noun.def: A box where letters are delivered or posted.

prosperity--noun.def: The state of being successful and having money.
prosperity--noun.ex: Trade brought prosperity to the port.

literary--adj.def: Relating to literature and its study.

northwest--adj.def: In or towards the direction between north and west.

northwest--noun.def: The direction between north and west.
northwest--noun.ex: The storm came from the northwest.

excess--noun.def: An amount that is more than needed.

unemployment--noun.def: The state of having no jobs available.

install--verb.def: To put equipment or software in place for use.

dependent--adj.def: Needing someone or something for support.
dependent--adj.ex: The village is dependent on tourism.

abnormal--adj.def: Different from what is usual in a worrying way.

bandage--noun.def: A strip of cloth wrapped around a wound.

generate--verb.def: To produce energy, money or ideas.

extinct--adj.def: No longer existing as a living species.
extinct--adj.ex: That bird became extinct long ago.
extinct--adj.exTr: O kuşun soyu çok önce tükendi.

recite--verb.def: To say a poem or a list aloud from memory.

pineapple--noun.def: A large tropical fruit with a rough skin.

workout--noun.ex: He does a short workout daily.
workout--noun.exTr: Her gün kısa bir antrenman yapıyor.

tightly--adv.def: Firmly, with no space left loose.

booking--noun.def: An arrangement made in advance for a seat or a room.

hasty--adj.def: Done too quickly and without enough thought.
hasty--adj.ex: Do not make a hasty decision.

acquire--verb.def: To get or learn something over time.
acquire--verb.ex: She acquired a taste for olives.

dedicate--verb.def: To give your time to something, or to offer a work to someone.
dedicate--verb.ex: He dedicated the book to his mother.

occupy--verb.def: To fill a space or time, or to take control of a place.
occupy--verb.ex: The desk occupies half the room.

cod--noun.def: A large sea fish with white flesh.

critic--noun.def: A person who judges books, films or art.

prejudice--noun.def: An unfair opinion formed without knowledge.

referee--noun.def: The official who controls a sports match.

southeast--adj.def: In or towards the direction between south and east.

southeast--noun.def: The direction between south and east.
southeast--noun.ex: The road runs to the southeast.

paddle--noun.def: A short oar used to move a small boat.
paddle--noun.ex: He lost a paddle in the river.

ingredient--noun.def: One of the foods used to make a dish.
ingredient--noun.ex: List every ingredient on the label.

attach--verb.def: To fasten one thing to another.
attach--verb.ex: Attach the photo to the form.

slope--noun.def: A surface that is higher at one end.
slope--noun.ex: The slope is covered in pines.

awareness--noun.def: Knowledge that something exists or matters.
